headline: Big Tech Hasn't Looked This Risky Relative To S&P 500 In 23 Years
summary: Nasdaq-100 Volatility Index and VIX spread has reached its widest level in at least 23 years, signaling more uncertainty into Big Tech than the broader S&P 500.

headline: Small Caps Are Beating S&P 500 By The Widest Margin Since 2003: Here’s Why
summary: U.S. small caps are beating the S&P 500 by the widest margin since 2003 as investors shift from AI hyperscalers to smaller infrastructure winners.

headline: Kalshi, Polymarket Could See Wave Of Cross-Industry M&A Bernstein Writes (CORRECTED)
summary: Bernstein warns Kalshi and Polymarket face takeover risk as Robinhood, Coinbase, and DraftKings build their own prediction market exchanges.

headline: AI Stocks Are On Sale — Dan Ives Calls It Another 'Gut Check' For Tech Investors
summary: Tech analyst Dan Ives says Big Tech is in an “air pocket stage” where billions of capex is funding AI datacenter and compute buildouts.
